podcast.body: This song from the band's 1998 album "Dexan Drums and Rock and Roll" was featured in the very first television commercial for iPods. Propellerheads were the first musical group to benefit from appearing in an iPod advertisement. "The very first band to benefit from appearing in an iPod commercial was the English electronic duo called Propellerheads. The ad agency chose this song from their 1998 album Dexan Drums and Rock and Roll for the first spot. It's called Take California."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Portable Music: Part 2

podcast.body: This track by the British group Propellerheads was the very first song to be featured in an iPod commercial. It appeared in the inaugural iPod advertisement in the fall of 2001, predating Apple's iconic silhouette campaigns.
